Question: How many strings of length \(5\) formed from the digits \(0,\) \(1,\) \(2,\) \(3,\) \(4\) are there such that for each \(j\in\{1,2,3,4\},\) at least \(j\) of the digits are less than \(j?\) (For example, \(02214\) satisfies the condition because it contains at least \(1\) digit less than \(1,\) at least \(2\) digits less than \(2,\) at least \(3\) digits less than \(3,\) and at least \(4\) digits less than \(4.\) The string \(23404\) does not satisfy the condition because it does not contain at least \(2\) digits less than \(2.\))
